title: Codeology assessment charter
summary: Codeology separates learning activity from inspectable evidence and records exactly what each assessment did and did not establish.

openToolPolicy.label: Open-tool
allowed: AI coding assistants and chat companions
openToolPolicy.assessedTarget: The submitted engineering artifact, its reproducible facts, criterion-level evidence, and the learner's response to any declared follow-up.
doesNotClaim: identity beyond the recorded identity-assurance level
openToolPolicy.companionPrivacy: Private AI companion conversations are outside assessment unless the learner explicitly opts in to a separately disclosed process.

evidenceStates.label: Learned
evidenceStates.definition: The learner consumed or understood instructional material.

evidenceStates.label: Practised
evidenceStates.definition: The learner attempted realistic work and supplied a learner-owned repository with public checks.

evidenceStates.label: Demonstrated
evidenceStates.definition: An immutable artifact passed Codeology's bounded, versioned review against public criteria.

evidenceStates.label: Verified
evidenceStates.definition: Codeology independently checked the immutable artifact and a freshly administered follow-up under controlled conditions.

artifactAssurance.label: Repository observed
artifactAssurance.meaning: A public immutable artifact was recorded without independent execution.

artifactAssurance.label: Commit-bound reviewed
artifactAssurance.meaning: Deterministic repository facts and bounded criterion review are bound to an immutable commit.

artifactAssurance.label: Independently executed
artifactAssurance.meaning: Codeology ran isolated checks against the immutable artifact.

artifactAssurance.label: Controlled follow-up
artifactAssurance.meaning: Independent execution was combined with a freshly administered change or defect.

rubricLevels.label: Insufficient
rubricLevels.anchor: Required evidence is absent, contradictory, or blocked by a published hard reject.

rubricLevels.label: Developing
rubricLevels.anchor: Some relevant evidence exists, but material gaps prevent the criterion from being met consistently.

rubricLevels.label: Competent
rubricLevels.anchor: The evidence meets the published criterion under the scenario's stated constraints.

rubricLevels.label: Strong
rubricLevels.anchor: The evidence meets the criterion and handles meaningful complexity, failure modes, or trade-offs beyond the competent anchor.

currentAvailability.message: Codeology currently records academy learning activity only. Practised, demonstrated, and verified claims are not yet issued.
